st.t: Read the notice board in Draynor Village.
Talk to Sarah in the South Falador Farm.
s: I think that'll be all for now.

st.t: Use a rope on the Strange Hole east of Draynor Manor.
Climb down into the Strange Hole east of Draynor Manor.
Go to the end of the cave and investigate the skeleton there.
Talk to Spria in Draynor Village.
Wear the reinforced goggles, then climb down into the Strange Hole east of Draynor Manor. Be prepared to fight Sourhog (level 37).
Return to Sarah in the South Falador Farm.
Return to Spria in Draynor Village.
